syllabus.name: Technology 7–8 Syllabus (2023)

Students must undertake practical learning and project work for most of the course time.

safety_and_dependency_boundaries: The website and programme do not grant permission to use equipment.
Current school WHS procedures, ESIS, teacher demonstrations, training and supervision override website wording.

Fixed disc-sander use requires current controls, teacher demonstration, required safety test, teacher permission and observed safe use; local PPE, emergency-stop and first-aid arrangements are Teacher to confirm.
Laser-cutter workflow, file checking, authorised material, ventilation, supervision and settings are Teacher to confirm; the key-tag activity is software practice, not machine authorisation.
Soldering/electronics work must not begin from this programme alone; approved circuitry, ratings, power, connections and local safety procedure are Teacher to confirm.
The supplied drawing must be opened at full size; a screen preview must not be measured, and unclear units/features must be referred to the teacher.
Weeks 4–10 practical content is a documented dependency gap; teacher-approved job sequence/checkpoint records are required before practical delivery is represented.
Student photos and researched images require current privacy, copyright, reuse and publishing decisions; public website access is not consent.
The optional executable is excluded pending local security and curriculum approval.
